fix_round_3.policy: physics-rule labels; no independent crash-time validation
fix_round_3.qmin: EFIT01 conflict >1.4; sustained >=1.5 for50ms supports absence unless ECE conflicts. Magnetics-only q is not MSE constrained. Prior train-rule candidates near1.1-1.3 are not reliable conflicts.
fix_round_3.relaxation: POSR>=6, period>=10ms, >=6edges, shuffled-time p<=.05. DIII-D reference48-108ms;10ms conservative guard, not universal tokamak limit.
fix_round_3.phase_null: Run-conditional fixed-count/span refractory shuffled times. Repeat physical-gap grouping and compare minimum CV over ALL groups in every null replicate; controls selection/multiplicity within an observable run.

fix_round_4.absent_class: tested absence only: no POSR periodic edge (3+ edges, 20-250 ms) on any valid ECE channel at nominal rho < quiet_core_max_rho over a complete +/-1.5 maximum-period observable context, noise-resolved on at least 2 channels (an edge counts only when its relative change is at least significance = 0.02), no profile-passing candidate or slow relaxation phase nearby, and no isolated POSR edge within isolated_edge_context_ms. EFIT01 q_min >= 1.5 sustained 50 ms is neither necessary nor sufficient: time only that prior supports is a q-prior state (split in fix round 5 into q_prior_ece_contradicted and q_prior_untested), exported as uncertain with the state name as the reason and never a benchmark negative.
fix_round_4.ece_validity: time is unobservable when, on a 5 ms moving mean of the valid channels, an adjacent-channel step ratio above ece_step_ratio inside nominal rho < ece_step_max_rho, or the channel nearest the EFIT axis (within ece_axis_max_distance_m) below ece_axis_to_max of the profile maximum, holds for at least 20 ms
fix_round_4.density_cutoff: second-harmonic X-mode cutoff 0.9*2*(f_ce/8.98 GHz)^2 with f_ce from the local field at the EFIT axis resonance F/R_axis (frequency/(2*27.992 GHz/T) at the nearest mapped channel times R_ch/R_axis), against the Thomson 90th-percentile density; Bt at R0 only where the axis field is unmapped
fix_round_4.prior_inputs: labels/prior_inputs/fix2_inputs.json (sawtooth_physics.py snapshot), listed in the label manifest
fix_round_4.thresholds_chosen_on: no split=test shot was used. ece_step_ratio 2, ece_axis_to_max 0.6 and the 20 ms sustain are the review's values; the 5 ms smoothing, rho 0.7 and 0.1 m limits are conservative priors; quiet_core_max_rho 0.5 is the review's rho < 0.5. isolated_edge_context_ms was 5.15 ms (the frame holdoff) in fix round 4, chosen on an exploration of 23 shots (20 train, 3 val: 186636, 189324, 190637) with an empty provenance record; fix round 5 replaces it by the TRAIN-only derivation in edge_context_derivation.json (see fix_round_5)

fix_round_5.isolated_edge_context_ms: 50 ms, derived on TRAIN cohort shots only (sawtooth_edge_context.py, edge_context_derivation.json; no val or test shot read) as the longest of 5.15 / 50 / 375 ms that keeps at least half of the TRAIN tested-absent time left by the 5.15 ms frame holdoff. The one-half limit is a stated trade-off, not a quantity the data fixes; the benchmark and absent_composition.json carry the 5.15 / 50 / 375 ms sensitivity row.
fix_round_5.density_cutoff: the local axis field F/R_axis is computed first and needs no Bt; where the axis resonance is unmapped the cutoff uses Bt at R0 if a Bt waveform exists, and the fixed 8e19 m^-3 guard only when neither is available; each record names the branch it took (density_guard status and cutoff_field)
fix_round_5.ece_validity: dead channels (median below the 0.5 keV observability floor, or fluctuation spread at most 0.1% of the level) are excluded from the adjacent-channel step-ratio test, since a cutoff step is one-sided and a dead channel is low on both sides
fix_round_5.q_prior: q_prior_ece_contradicted: q-prior time inside the absence-test context of a periodic edge or a profile candidate; q_prior_untested: the rest. Both are exported as uncertain with the state name as the reason and are never scored
